rubric.role_summary: Senior battery systems engineering role owning battery architecture and requirements for an electric mobility platform, including cell and pack modeling, operating strategy, and integration with BMS and controls teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior battery systems engineering role owning battery architecture and requirements for an electric mobility platform, including cell and pack modeling, operating strategy, and integration with BMS and controls teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience in battery systems engineering on a shipped product.
- Understanding of lithium-ion cell electrochemical behavior, thermal characteristics, and degradation mechanisms, and their implications for duty cycles and pack design.
- Experience building battery simulation models (equivalent-circuit, thermal, degradation, or pack-level).
- Experience with EV or electrified-powertrain battery systems.
- Experience defining BMS hardware or firmware requirements.
- BS or MS in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Cell characterization experience and familiarity with BMS state-estimation algorithms and their controls interfaces.
- Experience with advanced simulation tools and fast-charge protocol development and optimization.
- Background in small EVs, two-wheelers, or light electric mobility platforms; familiarity with requirements-management tools; and business acumen in framing engineering tradeoffs.
- Experience in battery systems engineering, with ownership of battery architecture and requirements on a shipped product rather than program support or analysis alone.
- Hands-on expertise building equivalent-circuit, thermal-network, degradation, and pack-level simulation models from scratch, not merely running models.
- Experience developing or validating EV or electrified-powertrain duty cycles and translating mission profiles into battery requirements and operating limits.
- Experience working directly with embedded teams to translate cell and pack behavior into BMS hardware and firmware requirements, including protection thresholds, contactor and fuse sizing, parallel-cell current balance, and fault-detection logic.
- Technical fluency in controls and embedded systems sufficient to participate in BMS and controls design reviews.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
resolved_ambiguities: The description says the role is available “at all levels,” while the qualifications specify “8+ years in battery systems engineering”; whether the threshold applies to every level needs clarification.
interpretation.resolution: The less restrictive 'all levels' interpretation removes the conflicting eight-year floor; the substantive battery architecture/ownership requirements remain.
